tools.name: find_muhurta
tools.description:
Auspicious windows (muhūrta) in a date range. Scans each day in the range and ranks windows for the subject. The pañcāṅga is computed for `eventPlace`, never defaulted to the birthplace.
Cost: 10 credits per call (only successful calls are charged; a sandbox key is free and returns a fixed sample).
